title: Metatake Film Filming-Locations Dataset
description: A structured, geocoded map of where films were shot and set: 17,341 locations across 1,917 films and 130 countries, each with WGS-84 coordinates. Distinguishes the filmed location from the narrative setting and records each place's role in the film. Curated and published by Metatake (https://metatake.net), an independent film-criticism platform. Fields include film ids (slug, IMDb, TMDB), place name, role, narrative setting, layer, kind, country, latitude, longitude, precision, and confidence. Method: https://metatake.net/methodology#locations
